criterion: 2 + 4(modal): .fs-modal-error inside DeleteShorePointModal (holder guard, #421), text = "One or more struts of this shore still hold deployed equipment — return it first."
how_reached: Delete is only rendered on an expanded PENDING card (ShorePointCard.tsx:434/462) and a Pending point never carries a deployment (operationStore.ts:253-259), so 'deploy, then open Delete' is impossible on one device. Used the cross-device race: A (http://localhost:5200, Admin) expanded the Pending card and opened the Delete confirm and LEFT IT OPEN; B (http://127.0.0.1:5200, Default member, joined by invite code) assigned+deployed LS 304 to that point; A ingested the deploy (board behind the modal showed Pending 0 / Assigned 1 / 'LS 304'), then A pressed the modal's Delete -> store rejected -> error line rendered.

Light/Dark = document.documentElement.dataset.theme flipped with the SAME modal + error line still rendered (1 s settle, then read); then flipped back to sunlight.
